items.title: Lennar (LEN) Extends Credit Facilities, Is The Stock Expensive?
items.summary: Lennar (LEN) amended its revolving credit and term loan facilities, increasing potential borrowing capacity to US$4.545b, extending key maturities, and adjusting SOFR-based pricing features that depend on future rating conditions. Lennar’s latest credit agreement changes land at a sensitive time for the stock, with the share price down 17.4% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return declining 27.7%.
